fragen.frage: Why is it effective to vary your voice when reading a poem aloud?
optionen: It makes the text sound more alive.
It hides the meaning of the poem.
It makes every line sound identical.
It removes all emotion.
fragen.erklaerung: Variation in Stimme und Intonation unterstützt die Wirkung eines Textes.

fragen.frage: What can a short pause after an important sentence do?
optionen: It gives the audience time to absorb the idea.
It always confuses the audience.
It makes the text grammatically wrong.
It stops the presentation completely.
fragen.erklaerung: Pausen setzen Akzente und geben dem Publikum Zeit zum Mitdenken.

fragen.frage: If you strongly stress one word in the sentence 'This was the turning point,' what happens?
optionen: The word becomes less important.
The key idea stands out more clearly.
The sentence changes language.
The sentence loses all rhythm.
fragen.erklaerung: Betonung lenkt die Aufmerksamkeit auf zentrale Wörter.

fragen.frage: Which choice makes a story sound more vivid?
optionen: Using a few descriptive details
Reading every word in the same flat tone
Skipping all adjectives
Speaking as fast as possible
fragen.erklaerung: Anschauliche Details helfen dem Publikum, Bilder im Kopf zu entwickeln.

fragen.frage: Why might a speaker slow down in an emotional moment?
optionen: To give the moment more weight
To show they have forgotten the text
To end the performance early
To remove all feelings from the scene
fragen.erklaerung: Langsameres Tempo kann Spannung oder Emotionalität verstärken.

fragen.frage: What is the best role of gestures in a short presentation?
optionen: They should support the meaning naturally.
They should distract from the content.
They should replace all words.
They should be repeated without purpose.
fragen.erklaerung: Sinnvolle Gesten unterstreichen Aussagen, ohne vom Inhalt abzulenken.

fragen.frage: When reading a dialogue aloud, what helps the audience notice different speakers?
optionen: Changing tone or rhythm slightly
Reading every line with exactly the same sound
Ignoring punctuation
Skipping direct speech
fragen.erklaerung: Kleine Unterschiede in Klang und Tempo machen Rollen hörbar.

fragen.frage: Why can repeating a phrase at the end of a speech be powerful?
optionen: It makes the ending easier to remember.
It always shortens the speech.
It removes the main idea.
It turns the speech into a worksheet.
fragen.erklaerung: Eine gezielte Wiederholung gibt dem Schluss Nachdruck.
